body:
This **Dhaka scene roundup** from 9 September 2026 opens with a simple promise on the cover: "Here's what you missed this week." The caption asks readers "Which one did you miss this week?" and invites them to name anything "we failed to capture on our radar."

## What's in the 9 September Dhaka scene roundup

It's a multi-slide carousel with a "Swipe to see" prompt, so the events are on the slides of the original post. The cover pairs a glowing "DHAKA" with an illustrated character in a red off-shoulder top, labelled "ARKA" in yellow. If the name rings a bell, our piece on [Special K x Omar Alkilani](post:special-k-omar-alkilani-arka) is about the magic produced by Arka.

## Following the radar week by week

The weekly roundups work best as a set. Each one shows which crews, venues and artists keep turning up, and the comments fill in what we missed. Earlier the same week we flagged the [Open to All art exhibition at Alliance Française de Dhaka](post:alliance-francaise-dhaka-open-art-exhibition), and the next edition of the series is the [22 September roundup](post:dhaka-scene-roundup-22-september-2026).

You'll find every edition on our [events and radar hub](topic:events), and the rest of the magazine on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdEbIWMmg9C/)
